title: TxnQA: Benchmarking Analytical Reasoning and Evidence Grounding over Transaction Event Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2610.27256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analyzing merchant transaction histories requires dynamic temporal filtering, entity resolution, and aggregation over irregular event streams--operations poorly captured by static tabular or time-series forecasting benchmarks. We introduce TxnQA, an analytical QA benchmark comprising 27 task families (81 templates) alongside a 5-scenario fraud-risk reasoning suite that evaluates both verdicts and supporting evidence over synthetic, privacy-mitigated transaction data. Ground-truth answers are computed programmatically, and model performance is decomposed into format-following rate (FFR), conditional content accuracy (CA), and end-to-end correctness (E2E). Evaluating prompted proprietary baselines and six LoRA-adapted open-weight models shows that adaptation reliably enforces output schemas but leaves arithmetic bottlenecks: Gemma-4-31B-IT and Qwen3-8B attain E2E scores of 0.867 and 0.816, whereas evaluated MoE checkpoints reach only 0.632

translated_title: TxnQA：针对交易事件序列的分析推理与证据溯源基准测试
translated_abstract: 分析商户交易历史需要在不规则事件流上进行动态时间过滤、实体解析和聚合操作——这些操作在静态表格或时间序列预测基准中难以得到充分体现。我们提出TxnQA，一个分析型问答基准，包含27个任务族（81个模板）以及一个5场景的欺诈风险推理套件，该套件在合成的、经隐私脱敏处理的交易数据上同时评估判定结果和支持证据。标准答案通过程序化方式计算，模型性能被分解为格式遵循率（FFR）、条件内容准确率（CA）和端到端正确性（E2E）。对基于提示的专有基线模型和六个经LoRA适配的开源权重模型的评估表明，适配能够可靠地规范输出模式，但仍存在算术瓶颈：Gemma-4-31B-IT和Qwen3-8B分别取得0.867和0.816的E2E分数，而所评估的MoE模型检查点仅达到0.632。
tldr: TxnQA提出了一个针对交易事件序列分析推理的新基准，包含27个任务族和欺诈风险推理套件，评估发现LoRA适配虽能有效规范输出格式，但算术能力仍是模型性能的主要瓶颈。
en_tdlr: TxnQA introduces a new benchmark for analytical reasoning over transaction event sequences with 27 task families and a fraud-risk reasoning suite, revealing that LoRA adaptation reliably enforces output schemas but arithmetic bottlenecks remain the key limitation.
